The amended bill is expected to be brought before the House plenum for a vote on Thursday. According to Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides, following a recent closed session of the House [...]
inputs.modified_text: They're pushing through changes to Cyprus' surveillance laws to strip out all judicial oversight, and it's no coincidence at all. Lawyers flagged it on Monday, but now the amended bill is being rushed to a House plenum vote on Thursday. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides raised it after a closed session, which just confirms they're keeping the real details hidden from the public. This is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites to expand unchecked monitoring of everyone with no safeguards left, and the speed plus secrecy is clear proof of a deliberate power grab rather than anything routine.
